provisional: Written by hand on 2026-11-20, before the findings log exists. Fields follow the finding format in issue #198 (02); issue #200 (03b) defines the log's file format and takes this file over. The human graded all three below Critical (FINDINGS_TO_ISSUE_AT=C), so none gets its own issue.

findings.recommendation: Fix kit-map's symlink-loop handling or its test for Python 3.13; covered by issue #141's filesystem-failure audit (pointed there 2026-11-20).
findings.what: tests/test_kit_fs_errors.py OtherExceptionsTest.test_a_real_symlink_loop_in_resolve_is_a_map_error fails on Python 3.13: Path.resolve() no longer raises on a symlink loop, so MapError is never raised. make verify is red for every issue until it is fixed, and kit-map may no longer report a symlink loop as a map error. Not caused by #196.
findings.how_found: make verify during #196 (Engineer, every QA launch).

findings.recommendation: Fix when a later issue first reads a setting from shell: either have that reader refuse these forms or state the limits in customizing.md.
findings.what: agent-kit/scripts/settings.py reads agent-kit.conf as text and does not parse bash, so the two can disagree. Bash sets a setting the reader passes over: LANES[0]=5, export 'LANES'=5, declare "LAN"ES=5, : ${LANES:=5}, printf -v LANES 5, read LANES <<< 5, eval "LAN""ES=5", . ./other.conf (or source), and a # continuation line inside a multi-line value followed by an assignment. The reader applies a column-1 line bash would not: inside if false ... fi, a function, a heredoc, after a backslash continuation, or inside a multi-line quoted value. Nothing reads settings from bash in #196, so no behaviour is affected today.
findings.how_found: QA probes during #196: .scratch/qa196_recheck_probe.py, qa196_2_probe.py, qa196_2b_probe.py (QA comments on #196).

findings.recommendation: Wire HEAVY_SECOND_QA=off at the project level in a later issue, or drop the value; until then customizing.md says off has no effect.
findings.what: HEAVY_SECOND_QA accepts on|off, but no 1.11 issue makes off do anything; issue #197 only refuses it as an override on a Heavy issue. The human chose to keep on|off and record this (2026-11-20).
